text:
B: Alright! How's it going?
A: Hi! Yeah, good, thanks. Sorry, I'm Megan. Chelmsford.
B: Zain, Bolton. You're the bird one, aren't you? With the chart?
A: Ha, yeah, that's me. Everyone keeps saying that. Sorry, is it a bit much?
B: Nah, it's sound. Better than a Live Laugh Love sign.
A: Oh no, did someone have one?
B: I'm not naming names. So what you doing, uni?
A: Yeah, second year, wildlife and conservation, out at Writtle. What about you?
B: Sparky. Electrician. Out at half six most days. My missus says I spend more time in other people's houses than ours.
A: My boyfriend's the same, he's a delivery driver. Multi-drop. He's out till like eight sometimes, and then he just falls asleep on the sofa with his dinner on his knee.
B: Ha, that's me with my tea. Is he in a van all day? The fuel's daylight robbery at the minute. I put forty quid in the work van Monday and it barely moved the needle.
A: Yeah, he moans about it every day. He's got one of the electric vans now, actually, and he says the charging's a nightmare.
B: See, that's my future, that. EV chargers. I'm going on my own in a couple of years, doing chargers and solar. Everyone's going electric, the vans, the cars, and somebody's got to fit the points. Might as well be me, do you know what I mean? I'll have a van with my name on it, Zain something Electrical. Still working on the something.
A: That's really cool. You sound like you've got it all worked out.
B: Mostly in my head, to be fair. Callum told me I need someone for the paperwork. And Gemma. Twice in one day.
A: Oh, Callum! I spoke to him. He was nicer than I thought, actually. He knew loads about ponds.
B: Ponds? Callum?
A: Yeah, drainage ponds. On housing estates. Like where newts can live if they do it properly.
B: Fair play to him. He told me about the drainage. He sold it better than I thought he would.
A: Erm, what do you do when you're not working? Sorry, that's such a boring question.
B: Nah, go on. Gym, five-a-side, football. And I take loads of pictures of buildings on my phone. Old mills, mostly. Sana thinks I'm weird.
A: That's not weird, I do the same with birds. Well, I draw them. I saw a kestrel by my bus stop yesterday and I did a li'le sketch of it on the bus.
B: On the bus? That's proper skills, the buses round ours, you'd end up drawing a scribble.
A: Ha, it did look a bit like a scribble, to be honest.
B: Where would you go, if you could go anywhere? I'm Japan. Been saving the flight deals for months.
A: Erm, I'd love to do turtle conservation. Like volunteering on a beach somewhere, helping the babies get to the sea. But it's really expensive, you have to pay to volunteer, which is mad, do you know what I mean?
B: Pay to work? Nah. Look for deals, though. I swear there's always a cheaper way to do it, you just have to dig.
A: Maybe. I'll have a look. Oh, I think we've only got a minute.
B: Go on then. Get that kestrel on Instagram.
A: Ha, maybe!
